notes:
POC summary and timeline:
- 2025-11-20: Intro call (AE Jordan + SE Maya). Use-case: long-term enterprise search over legal/regulatory archives, strong residency + retention controls required. Latency: sub-200ms for single-doc retrieval; throughput moderate (200 qps expected peak). Cost sensitivity: mid-high, prefer predictable reserved pricing. Models: prefer open LLaMA variants or fine-tuned LLMs that can be hosted in VPC/on-prem. Preferred deployment: private (VPC) but evaluating Dedicated for throughput.
- 2025-12-07: POC kickoff. Data subset ingested, embeddings index (approx 5M docs) built using Redwood embeddings. Tested reranking + retrieval-augmented generation. Initial latency targets met on Dedicated nodes, embeddings quality OK.
- 2026-01-18: Security review call. Infosec asked for encryption-at-rest proof, KMS/HSM integration details, and audit log retention policy. Filed security questionnaire (drive link above). SOC2 requested; provided partial evidence.
- 2026-02-02: Demo to ED/VP Eng. Positive feedback on QA but ED asked for cost model vs current search infra. AE provided cost projection deck (drive link).
- 2026-02-10: Final POC report delivered. Recommendation: Dedicated with private control plane and KMS integration. Proposed SOW attached.
Current state: POC complete; procurement moved to legal/security and finance. No internal champion identified after VP left the company in Jan; technical champion (SRE lead) is overloaded. Procurement flagged budget freeze until Q3. Competing proposal from a large cloud provider offering bundled storage+search with steep discounts.
Sales actions taken: multiple re-engagements (calls + emails) through Feb. 2026-02-15 last call — prospect unresponsive since. AE notes: "They liked the demo but execs are being conservative on new vendor risk right now." SE recommended a short follow-up pilot with stricter SLAs and an initial small reserved commitment to reduce exec risk; awaiting internal sign-off.
Next steps: one more executive outreach via VP of Sales and Customer Success; propose 3-month pilot with capped spend and escrowed SOC2 evidence. If no response by 2026-03-15, mark as stalled and set cadence for quarterly check-ins.
Key quotes: "We like the latency and cost math, but we can't onboard a new vendor until we resolve residency/legal questions and freeze lifts." — VP of Engineering.
Attachments: poc-report.pdf, security-answers-2026-02-04.docx, cost-projection-q1-2026.pptx
